heading: Tonight
text: Showers tapering off, possibly mixing with snow north, and over the higher terrain south. Lows in the upper 20s to mid 30s north, in the 30s to near 40 south. Northwest winds 10 to 20 mph, gusting 30 to 40 mph.

heading: Saturday
text: Morning clouds, with scattered snow showers through the northern mountains, flurries in the valleys and southern mountains, giving way to periods of sun in the mountains, and mostly sunny in the valleys. Windy and cold. Highs in the 30s to near 40 north, 40 to 45 through the Champlain Valley and south. Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting 25 to 35 mph.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Becoming mostly clear, with a few clouds in the St. Lawrence Valley late. Cold. Lows in the 20s to near 30. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly sunny, with a few clouds north. Not as cold, but still cool. Highs in the upper 40s to mid 50s. Light winds east of the Green Mountains, turning to the south in the afternoon from the Green Mountains west near 10 mph.
